verses.text: The man brought me back to the entrance of the temple. I saw water flowing out from under the threshold of the temple toward the east, since the temple faced east. The water was flowing down from under the south side of the temple, south of the altar.
Then he brought me out through the north gate and led me around the outside to the outer gate facing east. I saw the water trickling out from the south side.
The man went east with a measuring line in his hand. He measured one thousand cubits and led me through the water. It came up to my ankles.
He measured another thousand cubits and led me through the water. It came up to my knees. He measured another thousand and led me through the water. It came up to my waist.
He measured another thousand, and now it was a river I could not cross. The water had risen so high that it was deep enough to swim in, a river no one could walk across.
He asked me, "Son of man, do you see this?" Then he led me back to the bank of the river.
When I got back, I saw a great number of trees on both sides of the river.
He said to me, "This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Jordan Valley. When it flows into the Dead Sea, its salty water will become fresh.

Wherever the river flows, swarms of living creatures will live. There will be huge numbers of fish, because this water flows there and makes the salt water fresh. Everything will live wherever the river goes.

Fishermen will stand along the shore. From En Gedi to En Eglaim there will be places to spread fishing nets. There will be many kinds of fish, just like the fish of the Mediterranean Sea, a great many of them.
But its swamps and marshes will not become fresh. They will be left for salt.

Fruit trees of every kind will grow on both banks of the river. Their leaves will not dry up, and their fruit will never fail. They will produce fresh fruit every month, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will be for food and their leaves for healing."
This is what the Lord GOD says: "These are the borders by which you will divide the land as an inheritance among the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph will have two portions.
Divide it equally among them. I swore with raised hand to give it to your ancestors, so this land will be your inheritance.
"These are the borders of the land. On the north side, it will run from the Mediterranean Sea by the Hethlon road to Lebo Zedad,
Hamath, Berothah, and Sibraim, which lies between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath, as far as Hazer Hatticon, on the border of Hauran.
So the border will run from the sea to Hazar Enan, along the border of Damascus, with the border of Hamath to the north. This is the north side.
"On the east side, the border will run between Hauran and Damascus, along the Jordan between Gilead and the land of Israel, down to the Dead Sea. This is the east side.
"On the south side, it will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. This is the south side.
"On the west side, the Mediterranean Sea will be the border, up to a point opposite Lebo Hamath. This is the west side.
"Divide this land among yourselves by the tribes of Israel.

Divide it by lot as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners who live among you and have children here. Treat them like people born in Israel. They will receive an inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
In whatever tribe a foreigner lives, give him his inheritance there, says the Lord GOD."
